entries.test: Whether a system meeting Hassabis's definition of AGI (all human cognitive capabilities, including breakthrough invention and physical intelligence) appears no earlier than 2031 and by about 2036.
entries.note: Marcus says he is '100%' with the estimate, so the drafter's 'likely' modality understates how firm he is. The forecast relies on Hassabis's 5-to-10-year range, counted from January 2026.

entries.test: Whether any system meeting Hassabis's definition of AGI, which Marcus shares, is publicly shown before the decade ends (end of 2029 or 2030).
entries.note: Readers may disagree on whether 'this decade' ends in 2029 or 2030. The target field 'current AI systems' is imprecise, since the claim is about AGI.
